intelligence.enrichment: Cooked vegetables can lose bright colour and become softer or less crisp, and some nutrients such as vitamin C can be affected during cooking. cooking vegetables -> changes in colour and texture, with possible loss of some nutrients The learner correctly applies this rule: Cooked vegetables can lose bright colour and become softer or less crisp, and some nutrients such as vitamin C can be affected during cooking. Cooked vegetables either keep all nutrients unchanged or lose every nutrient completely.
